【Service suspended】The convenience store service for issuing family register certificates and family register attachments has been unavailable due to a system error since around 6:30 a.m. on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 (Reiwa 8). We will announce the restoration time on our website as soon as it is confirmed.

If you need a family register certificate or family register attachment issued during this period, please use one of the following locations:

• Hanno City Hall and each district administrative center (excluding Fujimi District Administrative Center): 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
• Hanno Station Service Counter: 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/johosystem/13166.html
